item.title: The STAR WARS HOLIDAY SPECIAL Was Misrepresented as a Sequel and That’s Where Everything Went Wrong
item.description: When the Star Wars Holiday Special aired on CBS in 1978, it didn’t just confuse audiences, it flat-out blindsided them. Coming off the massive success of Star Wars, fans tuned in expecting something that felt like a continuation of that galaxy far, far away.
